links.outcome: Omissions and errors in AI-generated outside-record summaries rated by clinicians
links.effect: Thoroughness without omission rated low in 28 (45%) of 62 summaries; errors in 25 (40%) surveys, 13 (52%) treatment-impacting; imaging errors most common (17, 68%).
links.quote: Thoroughness without omission was rated low in 28 (45%) summaries.

links.outcome: Frequency and criticality of errors in AI summaries that clinicians would need to verify
links.effect: Errors were noted in 25 (40%) surveys, with 13 (52%) classified as critical (treatment-impacting).
links.quote: Errors were noted in 25 (40%) surveys, with 13 (52%) classified as critical (treatment-impacting).

screen.reason: Prospective pilot evaluation of a RAG-enabled GPT-4o summarization agent by clinicians reviewing outside breast surgical oncology records, measuring clinical workflow impact and error rates.
